query:
WITH IndividualTrips AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        dependent_seq_no,
        COUNT(*) AS total_trips
    FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala
    WHERE (YEAR(entry_date) >= 2023 OR YEAR(exit_date) >= 2023)
    AND entry_date IS NOT NULL OR exit_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY id, dependent_seq_no
)
SELECT 
    AVG(total_trips) AS average_trips_per_individual
FROM IndividualTrips LIMIT 20000
